edges.reason: msg.sender is validated by the canManageStreams modifier before opening a stream.
openStream reads isSubGov[msg.sender] to authorize the caller.
openStream stores uint128(block.timestamp) as the stream startTime.
openStream increases totalUnclaimedInStreams by totalAmount.
openStream writes a new Stream struct into the streams mapping.
openStream checks pool balance against totalUnclaimedInStreams.
closeStream is guarded by the canManageStreams modifier using msg.sender.
closeStream calls payout before clearing the stream entry.
closeStream resets the stream struct to zero values.
payout derives currentTime from block.timestamp to gate the stream.
payout invokes yam.transferUnderlying, an external call transferring value.
The external transferUnderlying call can re-enter payout/closeStream.
payout decreases totalUnclaimedInStreams by the claimable amount.
payout updates the stream amountPaidOut field.
payout delegates claimable computation to _claimable.
_claimable uses block.timestamp to compute elapsed time.
pay is guarded by onlyGovOrSubGov which checks msg.sender against gov and isSubGov.
pay derives the spending epoch from block.timestamp via _currentEpoch.
pay calls _currentEpoch to determine the current monthly epoch.
pay reads and writes spentPerEpoch for the monthly limit check.
pay performs SafeERC20.safeTransferFrom pulling funds from reserves.
initialize is guarded by the onlyGov modifier on msg.sender.
initialize sets timeInitialized = block.timestamp.
initialize writes the timeInitialized state variable.
initialize sets the initialized flag to true.
_currentEpoch computes elapsed time from block.timestamp minus timeInitialized.
rebase is guarded by onlyRebaser which compares msg.sender to rebaser.
rebase multiplies/divides yamsScalingFactor with BASE and indexDelta.
rebase writes the new yamsScalingFactor.
rebase recomputes totalSupply from initSupply and scaling factor.
rebase reads initSupply when recomputing totalSupply.
mint is guarded by onlyMinter which checks msg.sender against privileged roles.
mint delegates to the internal _mint implementation.
mint increases totalSupply.
mint credits _yamBalances[to].
mint increases initSupply.
mint moves delegates after updating the minter balance.
transfer operations use msg.sender as the debited account.
transfer updates _yamBalances for sender and recipient.
transfer calls _moveDelegates to move vote checkpoints.
transfer computes yamValue via _fragmentToYam then debits balances.
openStream returns and increments streamIndex from streamCount.
permit enforces now <= deadline using block.timestamp.
permit recovers the signer with ecrecover.
permit increments nonces[owner] as part of the digest.
permit uses owner parameter for digest and ecrecover comparison.
delegateBySig enforces now <= expiry using block.timestamp.
delegateBySig recovers the signatory with ecrecover.
delegateBySig validates and increments nonces[signatory].
delegateBySig calls _delegate which moves delegate checkpoints.
stake first calls _getLPToken to acquire LP tokens.
stake performs an external call staking.stake(amount).
stake reads LP balance into the amount local before staking.
getUnderlying calls _getUnderlyingToken to unwind positions.
_getLPToken reads and sets the complete action flag.
_getLPToken relies on recencyCheck which reads blockTimestampLast.
_getLPToken selects amount_ from sell_amount or purchase_amount.
_getLPToken computes quoted price and bounds checks it.
_getLPToken computes the counter amount_b from the quote.
_getLPToken performs external token transfers and UniswapPair.mint.
_getUnderlyingToken checks the complete flag.
_getUnderlyingToken transfers LP tokens and burns them via the pair.
execute is externally callable and performs privileged governance actions.
execute terminates by calling selfdestruct on the StreamManager.
execute calls MONTHLY_ALLOWANCE.pay for contributor payments.
execute calls pool.closeStream for existing streams.
execute calls pool.openStream to create new streams.
update_twap uses block.timestamp for cumulative price calculation.
update_twap writes blockTimestampLast and computes timeElapsed.
update_twap writes priceAverageSell.
update_twap increments twap_counter.
update_twap updates priceCumulativeLastSell.
consult reads priceAverageSell to derive the quote.
consult uses period-related averages to compute the TWAP price.
_acceptGov requires msg.sender == pendingGov.
_acceptGov clears pendingGov and promotes it.
_acceptGov sets gov to the pending governor.
flipBreaker is guarded by onlyGov using msg.sender.
flipBreaker sets the breaker flag to true.
setSubGov is guarded by onlyGov using msg.sender.
setSubGov writes isSubGov[account].
acceptGov requires msg.sender == pendingGov.
acceptGov sets gov to pendingGov.
acceptGov clears the pendingGov pointer.
transferFrom debits _allowedFragments[from][msg.sender].
transferFrom updates _yamBalances of from and to.
transferFrom calls _moveDelegates after balance changes.
rescueTokens is guarded by onlyGov on msg.sender.
rescueTokens performs SafeERC20.safeTransfer of arbitrary tokens.
payout stores the claimable amount in claimableUnderlying.
pay stores _currentEpoch result into epoch.
pay accumulates amount into newPaidThisEpoch with SafeMath add.
rebase computes newScalingFactor using SafeMath mul/div.
openStream stores totalAmount into the Stream struct.
openStream stores length into the Stream struct.

normalization_plan.reason: Stream duration parameter is stored directly into streams[streamIndex].length by openStream.
Stream recipient parameter is written into the Stream struct created by openStream.
Total streamed amount parameter feeds totalUnclaimedInStreams and the Stream struct.
Local stream index is derived from streamCount inside openStream.
Stream identifier parameter indexes the streams mapping in payout.
Local claimable amount is computed and transferred by payout.
Payment amount parameter is accumulated into spentPerEpoch and transferred by pay.
Epoch local computed from block.timestamp indexes spentPerEpoch in pay.
Running epoch total local is compared with MONTHLY_LIMIT in pay.
Rebase delta parameter drives the scaling factor arithmetic in rebase.
Rebase direction parameter selects increase or decrease of yamsScalingFactor.
Candidate scaling factor local is clamped and stored by rebase.
Mint recipient parameter is credited in _yamBalances within mint.
Fragment value parameter is converted to yamValue and debited by transfer.
Underlying value local is moved between balances in transfer.
Deadline parameter is compared against block.timestamp in permit.
Owner parameter is signature-checked and written into _allowedFragments.
Sale/purchase amount local is bounded and forwarded in _getLPToken.
Quoted reserve price local feeds withinBoundsWithQuote checks in _getLPToken.
Counter-asset amount local is transferred for liquidity in _getLPToken.
